stem.text: The genome of the bacterium *Escherichia coli* has been altered to enable it to code for an amino acid that is not found in nature. All the ATC DNA stop triplets on the strand of DNA that is transcribed have been substituted to ATT. The ATC triplet can then be inserted to code for the new amino acid. A new tRNA can then be constructed to carry the new amino acid.
What is the anticodon of this new tRNA?
